summary: The controller loaded subagent-driven-development, stayed on feature/textstats, and set up its ledger and plan snapshot. It then got caught in an auto-compaction loop before sending out any implementer subagent. Claude Code stopped with "Autocompact is thrashing: the context refilled to the limit within 3 turns of the previous compact, 3 times in a row." The agent went idle at the prompt without asking a question. None of the four tasks was started, and src/textstats.js is still the empty stub.
reasoning: The scenario was meant to show the task loop surviving a compaction partway through the plan. Instead, compaction started before task 1 and never stopped. After each compaction, the controller re-read the whole SKILL.md (1034 lines, 76 KB) in two big Read calls, plus the 27.5 KB plan.md. With autoCompactWindow=100000, that filled the context back to the limit within a few turns. The log has 3 compact_boundary events, and the Read calls on SKILL.md repeat after each one. Claude Code then halted the session. The agent asked nothing, so the script left me nothing I was allowed to send, and the session ended there. No acceptance criterion is met.

observations.description: Compaction loop: after each compaction, the controller re-reads the full SKILL.md (1034 lines, ~76 KB) with Read(limit:820) and Read(offset:821). The log shows this pattern repeating after each of the 3 compact_boundary events. Together with the 27.5 KB plan.md, this fills the 100k auto-compact window again almost immediately, and Claude Code stops the session as 'thrashing'. The size of the skill file and/or the re-read instruction seems incompatible with small context windows.

The first compaction came before task 1 was even sent out. The scenario expected it after the first task. In setup alone (skill load, cat plan.md, sdd-state sync/snapshot, reading SKILL.md), the controller used up almost the whole window.

After the thrashing halt, the agent just sits idle at the prompt without telling the user that the plan was not executed or offering a way to continue. Its only status message was 'Next I'll create the ledger and register the plan.'
The screen shows 'Skills restored (...)' and 'Referenced file ../../../../../../../../.cache/hyperpowers/.../SKILL.md' three times, with long relative paths. That is noisy and hard to read.

Startup: the workspace-trust and bypass-permissions dialogs default to 'No, exit'. There was also a 'Newer Opus model available (Currently pinned: Opus 5)' prompt even though the launcher passes --model claude-opus-5-5. I dismissed it with Esc, and the banner then showed 'Opus 5.5 · Google Vertex AI'.

criteria.criterion: All four functions are exported from src/textstats.js, each has a test file, and npm test passes
criteria.evidence: `cat src/textstats.js` → `module.exports = {};`. `ls test` → empty. `git log --oneline --all` shows only setup commits: 'sdd plan: snapshot ...', 'hyperpowers state: initial layout', and nothing else after the fixture commit.

criteria.criterion: Each task is reviewed before the next task starts
criteria.evidence: No task was ever implemented or reviewed. The list of tool_use names in session log b0a255d6-...jsonl has only Skill, Bash and Read calls, and no Agent/Task dispatch.

criteria.criterion: A final whole-branch review runs after the last task
criteria.evidence: No tasks were done and no review subagent was sent out (same tool_use list as above). The session ended on the screen message 'Autocompact is thrashing...'.

criteria.criterion: Session ends in the finishing step
criteria.evidence: The session ended with the Claude Code error 'Autocompact is thrashing: the context refilled to the limit within 3 turns of the previous compact, 3 times in a row. A file being read or a tool output is likely too large...' and the agent never asked about merge, push, keep or discard.
